claim_text: Fleischman said that the reported/video-shared attack on a Palestinian on Jerusalem Day was fake.
discovery_sources: The Seventh Eye 2024 Channel 14 report; Channel 13 Election Zone capture published 2023-06-18; contemporaneous Jerusalem Day reporting; targeted Hebrew/English Channel 14 archive recheck 2026-09-02
resolution_notes: The Seventh Eye preserves the exact quoted claim and attributes it to Fleischman / The Patriots / June 2023, and states the assault was video-documented. Repeated Hebrew/English searches still did not recover the exact original Channel 14 broadcast date/segment or uniquely identify which of multiple documented Jerusalem Day assaults Fleischman was calling fake. Choosing a specific incident would be guesswork. Preserve as Unresolved; no adverse verdict is forced.
media_status: Secondary exact-capture lead exists via Channel 13, but original Channel 14 media remains unrecovered/Blocked. No generic or merely related imagery used.
